about_short_description.short_description: Worklytics is a tool that provides workforce analytics centered on productivity and collaboration.

product.name: Worklytics Platform
product.description: A workplace analytics platform that uses anonymized collaboration and AI usage data to measure work patterns, productivity, and team health.

product.name: Worklytics Data Stream
product.description: A cloud-based service that collects, anonymizes, and processes metadata from over 25 productivity tools to generate over 400 workforce metrics for analysis and reporting.

product.name: Measure AI / AI Adoption Analytics
product.description: An analytics solution that connects to corporate AI tools to track AI adoption, usage patterns, and productivity impact across teams.

product.name: AI Adoption Analytics
product.description: A tool that measures and benchmarks AI tool adoption and usage across teams by analyzing log data from corporate AI applications to track progress and identify adoption gaps.

product.name: HR Workplace Benchmarking Platform
product.description: A platform providing workflow and collaboration benchmarks across roles and industries to compare organizational work habits and performance metrics.

product.name: Organizational Data API
product.description: An API that delivers cleaned, anonymized real-time workplace data and metrics from multiple tools for custom analytics and models.
